records.text: And this year alone, God has used PreBorn! to save nearly 60,000 babies from abortion. Since Roe v. ... Wade was overturned, the abortion industry has not slowed down. It actually has adapted. Women now face this decision faster, more privately and more alone than ever.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
